title: Household Loyalty Rate Ladder — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
The household rate on an Alignment Services & Plans household plan depends on the household plan's loyalty, read from two figures of the household plan the customer already holds:

- **tenure** — the whole calendar months the household plan has been held, from its purchase date to the new purchase;
- **loyalty count** — the number of alignments booked as included in the plan on the household plan in the trailing 24 calendar months (dated less than 24 whole calendar months before the new purchase).

| Tier | Tenure | Loyalty count | Household rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Top | at least 24 months | at least 3 | 25% |
| Middle | at least 12 months | at least 2, short of the top tier | 18% |
| Otherwise | — | — | 10% |

### Combinations (hypothetical household plans)
| Tenure | Loyalty count | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 30 months | 3 | 25% |
| 30 months | 2 | 18% — misses the top count, meets the middle tier |
| 23 months | 5 | 18% — short of 24 months |
| 12 months | 2 | 18% |
| 11 months | 4 | 10% |
| 40 months | 1 | 10% |
